questions.q: Before Dynamic Forms, what controls every field a user sees on a record's Details tab?
options: The single assigned page layout — all-or-nothing for every user on it
A per-field visibility rule
A Lightning web component
The compact layout
questions.explain: Without Dynamic Forms, the page layout controls every field as one all-or-nothing block for anyone assigned that layout.

questions.q: What does migrating a page to Dynamic Forms actually do?
options: Deletes all fields from the record
Breaks each field and section apart into its own individually placed component on the Lightning App Builder canvas
Converts all fields into a single Apex class
Removes the need for a page layout entirely in every case
questions.explain: Migration turns fields/sections from one page-layout block into individually placed, individually configured components.

questions.q: Once a field is a component under Dynamic Forms, what new capability does it gain?
options: It can be deleted from Object Manager automatically
It automatically becomes a required field
It can no longer be edited by any user
It can carry its own visibility rule, a filter deciding whether it renders
questions.explain: Dynamic Forms lets each field-component carry its own filter-based visibility rule, independent of other fields.

questions.q: Before Dynamic Forms, how would you typically show a field only under certain conditions (e.g. a high deal amount)?
options: By creating a second picklist value
By using the standard App Launcher
It was effectively impossible without Apex or a workaround — the page layout had no per-field conditional visibility
It was just as easy as with Dynamic Forms
questions.explain: Before Dynamic Forms, conditional field visibility needed Apex or a hack, since the page layout applies uniformly to everyone on it.

questions.q: What does the Dynamic Forms migration process require, per this lesson?
options: A full Apex deployment
Picking the existing page layout to migrate fields from, via Lightning App Builder's own wizard
Manually recreating every field from scratch
Disabling all page layouts org-wide first
questions.explain: The migration is driven by a wizard inside Lightning App Builder that pulls fields from an existing page layout — it's declarative, not a rebuild from scratch.
